Article Title: Centre moves Supreme Court to quash FIRs against NEET protesters
Article Text:
Centre seeks SC intervention over FIRs against NEET protesters

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: The Centre has moved Supreme Court seeking to quash the FIRs registered against protesters in connection with alleged violence during protests over the NEET paper leak in Delhi and other states.Solicitor general Tushar Mehta mentioned the plea before a bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant on Monday, seeking the court’s intervention in the matter, news agency ANI reported.The Centre has urged the Supreme Court to exercise its extraordinary powers under Article 142 of the Constitution to quash the FIRs registered against the protesting students.The case is scheduled to be heard by the Supreme Court on September 1.Meanwhile, the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) has announced a fresh protest march in Delhi on September 5 over what it says are unfulfilled government assurances to protesters. The march will begin at India Gate and proceed towards Delhi Police headquarters, with families of NEET victims and those alleging police brutality expected to lead it.
Article Summary: Solicitor general Tushar Mehta mentioned the plea before a bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant on Monday. The Centre has urged the Supreme Court to exercise its extraordinary powers under Article 142 of the Constitution to quash the FIRs registered against the protesting students.

Article Title: File FIR against those who did 'purification': Priyanka to PM Modi
Article Text:
Priyanka Gandhi urges PM Modi to order FIR against those who "purified" Kharge's Haldwani rally venue.

NEW DELHI: Keeping up the pressure over the issue, Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra on Sunday appealed to Prime Minister Narendra Modi to order an FIR against the persons who had committed the crime of "purification" of the rally venue in Haldwani where Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge had recently addressed a public meeting, reports Devbrat Chaudhary.The appeal to the PM came a day after Rahul Gandhi addressed a press conference alleging the "purification" was the handiwork of BJP-RSS elements, and that a case should be lodged under the SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act. Priyanka posted on X, "Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge addressed a rally in Haldwani, after which people from BJP-RSS 'purified' his stage. This 'purification' is not only a symbol of an extremely reprehensible and shameful mindset but also a grave violation of our Constitution and the SC/ST Act, and is a crime."Priyanka said no action has been taken even 20 days after the "crime" and sought from the Prime Minister and Modi govt reasons for their "indifference"."If PM Modi truly respects the Constitution of our country, then he should ensure that an FIR is filed against those who committed this crime and that action is taken," she said.
Article Summary: Priyanka Gandhi Vadra urges PM Modi to order FIR against those who "purified" Kharge's Haldwani rally venue. Priyanka: "This 'purification' is not only a symbol of an extremely reprehensible and shameful mindset but also a grave violation of our Constitution and the SC/ST Act, and is a crime"

Article Title: Asian Games medallist Manpreet Kaur, 39 others join BJP ahead of Punjab polls
Article Text:
40 leaders join BJP

Asian Games gold medallist Manpreet Kaur , farmer leader Nirmal Singh and 38 others from Punjab joined the BJP on Sunday, ahead of the state Assembly elections scheduled early next year, the party said.The new entrants include former members of the Aam Aadmi Party, Congress and Shiromani Akali Dal, along with people from the farming, trading, social work and business sectors. They are from Patiala, Mansa, Patran and Lehragaga.Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini welcomed them into the BJP and said the growing number of people joining the party reflected increasing faith in Prime Minister Narendra Modi's development agenda and the BJP's welfare policies.Saini also said people in Punjab had become “disillusioned” with the AAP government as their expectations had not been met, and were now looking at the BJP as an alternative. He said the BJP's focus remained on development, good governance and public service.
Article Summary: 40 leaders join BJP ahead of state Assembly elections scheduled early next year. New entrants include former members of the Aam Aadmi Party, Congress and Shiromani Akali Dal. They are from Patiala, Mansa, Patran and Lehragaga.

Article Title: Billboard removal row: Abhishek Banerjee receives police notice over office scuffle
Article Text:
Kolkata police served a notice on TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee regarding a recent scuffle. He has been asked to appear at the police station on Tuesday noon.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Senior Trinamool Congress (TMC) leader Abhishek Banerjee has been served a police notice over a scuffle involving private security guards at his office and a team of police personnel and civic body officials, a police officer said on Sunday."A notice has been served on Abhishek Banerjee in connection with the investigation. He has been asked to appear before the investigating officer. The investigation is underway, and all aspects of the incident are being examined," the Kolkata Police officer told PTI.The notice was delivered to Abhishek Banerjee at his residence on Saturday evening. The TMC national general secretary has been asked to appear before the Shakespeare Sarani Police Station on September 1 for questioning.Three FIRs have been registered in connection with the August 27 incident. Diamond Harbour MP Abhishek Banerjee, nephew of TMC supremo and former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee, has been named as an accused in two cases. Other TMC leaders, including Rajya Sabha MP Derek O'Brien and former MLA Humayun Kabir, have also been named in the FIRs.O'Brien was served a notice on Sunday.The incident occurred at Banerjee's Camac Street office, where private security guards, supporters and some TMC leaders allegedly clashed with police and Kolkata Municipal Corporation (KMC) officials who had arrived to dismantle an "unauthorised" billboard.O'Brien, who was present at the spot during the raid, dismissed reports of resistance by the private guards as "fake news", claiming they were merely deployed on duty at the building's entrance.The billboard, which carried TMC signage and was mounted on an iron structure facing the road on the building's top floor, was dismantled by KMC personnel after police forced their way inside. It was later reinstalled by Abhishek Banerjee and other TMC leaders.Fourteen people have so far been arrested in connection with the incident. Police are examining CCTV footage and other evidence as part of the ongoing investigation.Meanwhile, police on Saturday registered a suo motu FIR against Mamata Banerjee for allegedly violating conditions laid down by the Calcutta high court for a foundation day event of the Trinamool Chhatra Parishad (TMCP), the party's student wing.The FIR was registered at Hastings Police Station against Banerjee and the organisers of the TMCP meeting. The development is likely to further intensify tensions between the BJP and TMC, which was voted out of power in April after 15 years in government.
Article Summary: TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee served police notice over scuffle at his office. He has been asked to appear at the police station on Tuesday noon. Three FIRs have been registered in connection with the August 27 incident.

Article Title: Lok Sabha Secretariat issues notices to 20 rebel TMC MPs
Article Text:
TMC rebel MPs after attending the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) Parliamentary Party Meeting (ANI photo)

NEW DELHI: The Lok Sabha Secretariat has issued notices to 20 rebel Trinamool Congress (TMC) MPs who have aligned with NCPI and sought their responses within seven days on petitions filed by TMC national general secretary and MP Abhishek Banerjee seeking their disqualification under the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution that lays down the anti-defection framework.Dated Aug 25, the notices to the 20 rebel MPs forward a copy of Banerjee’s petition dated June 18 filed against the MPs under Rule 6 of the Members of Lok Sabha (Disqualification on Ground of Defection) Rules, 1985.In a post on X, TMC Lok Sabha MP Mahua Moitra shared the photo of one of the notices issued to rebel MPs and said, “Cover up caught out!” Highlighting that TMC had filed 20 disqualification petitions in June, Moitra said, “Speaker LS did nothing except give them better seats at our expense. SG Tushar Mehta in Court said the Speaker had issued notices. Notice dated Aug 25th -- exact date of hearing!”On Tuesday, Supreme Court sought a response from Lok Sabha Speaker’s office on time-bound adjudication of TMC’s petition seeking disqualification of rebel MPs who broke away from the party after its electoral debacle in West Bengal, even as Abhishek Banerjee accused Speaker Om Birla of “deliberate inaction”.The SC also issued notices to the 20 rebel MPs: Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar, Sudip Bandyopadhyay, Satabdi Roy, Prasun Banerjee, Rachna Banerjee, Jagadish Chandra Barma Basunia, Partha Bhowmick, Arup Chakraborty, Adhikari Deepak Dev, Sayani Ghosh, Bapi Haldar, Abu Teher Khan, Kalipada Saren Kherwal, Asit Kumar Mal, June Maliah, Mitali Bag, Kalilur Rahaman, Mala Roy, Sharmila Sarkar and Yusuf Pathan.In his petition, Abhishek Banerjee told the court on Tuesday that he had lodged the disqualification petition against the rebel MPs on June 18 and complained that despite the lapse of two months, no meaningful progress has been made on its adjudication.The continuing delay in the adjudication process is impacting democratic governance, he said.In the recently concluded Monsoon session, Banerjee had met the Speaker on Aug 12 to reiterate his demand for a speedy decision on the disqualification petitions submitted to him in June. Banerjee had earlier met Birla on July 27 in Parliament urging him to expedite his decision on the pending petitions.
Article Summary: The Lok Sabha Secretariat has issued notices to 20 rebel Trinamool Congress (TMC) MPs who have aligned with NCPI. The notices sought their responses within seven days on petitions filed by TMC national general secretary and MP Abhishek Banerjee seeking their disqualification.

Article Title: Congress minister threatens to quit TVK cabinet if Rahul Gandhi is not accepted as PM candidate in 2029
Article Text:
A Congress minister threatened to resign from the cabinet over the prime ministerial candidate for 2029.





KANYAKUMARI: Amidst TVK propaganda projecting chief minister C Joseph Vijay as a prospective prime minister, Congress leader and Tamil Nadu tourism minister S Rajesh Kumar on Sunday said he would quit the cabinet if TVK refuses to accept Rahul Gandhi as the PM candidate in the 2029 Lok Sabha elections.“Rahul Gandhi will be the prime ministerial candidate for the 2029 parliamentary election. He will become the next PM. If at all TVK refuses to accept this, the two Congress ministers will walk out of the cabinet,” Rajesh Kumar said on Sunday at the swearing in ceremony of George Robinson as Congress party’s Kanyakumari West district unit president. “For us, party is above all other considerations. Our cadres want to see Rahul Gandhi as PM. Our goal is to achieve that,’’ he said.The remark comes against the backdrop of repeated attempts by TVK leaders to project chief minister C Joseph Vijay as a potential prime ministerial face from Tamil Nadu in 2029.The issue was first raised by PWD minister Aadhav Arjuna during a debate on delimitation exercise when he said a Prime Minister should emerge from Tamil Nadu. His remarks were followed by other TVK ministers, including D Sarathkumar, A Srinath and K Jagadeeswari, projecting Vijay as a possible prime ministerial candidate.The debate gained traction nationally after a private media house said their survey has found Vijay was the third most preferred prime ministerial choice in the country, following Prime Minister Narendra Modi and leader of the opposition Rahul Gandhi.The statements by TVK leaders sparked unease among the Congress rank and file. When asked about the issue, Tamil Nadu Congress Committee president Manickam Tagore took a swipe at TVK ministers, saying they were still functioning with a “fan club mindset.”Rajesh Kumar’s warning, however, marks an escalation of the disagreement. The support of five MLAs of Congress remains crucial for TVK to enjoy the majority mark in the state assembly. In return, TVK has given two ministerial berths to Congress leaders Rajesh Kumar and P Viswanathan, the higher education minister. Earlier in the day, when asked how many prime ministerial candidates were there in the TVK-led alliance, Viswanathan said at Trichy airport that Rahul Gandhi is the sole prime ministerial candidate of Indian National Congress, and there would be no change in the stand.
Article Summary: Tamil Nadu tourism minister S Rajesh Kumar said he would quit the cabinet if TVK refuses to accept Rahul Gandhi as the PM candidate in the 2029 Lok Sabha elections. The remark comes against the backdrop of repeated attempts by TVK leaders to project chief minister C Joseph Vijay as a potential prime ministerial face from Tamil Nadu.

Article Title: Delhi shocker: 16-year-old girl allegedly gang-raped inside bus, driver, conductor held
Article Text:
A 16-year-old student was allegedly gang-raped inside a sleeper bus

(The victim's identity has not been revealed to protect her privacy as per Supreme court directives on cases related to sexual assault)





NEW DELHI: A 16-year-old Class 11 student was allegedly gang-raped inside a sleeper bus before being abandoned at Kashmere Gate on August 4, following which Delhi Police arrested the bus driver and conductor, police sources said.The incident occurred after the girl, who was travelling from Uttar Pradesh to meet her cousin in Noida, mistakenly got off at Pari Chowk amid heavy rain.The accused have been identified as Kuldeep and Sandeep from Uttar Pradesh, who worked as the bus driver and conductor respectively. Delhi Police also seized the UP-registered bus and initiated a probe into the incident.During inquiry, the accused allegedly told police that they thought they would not get caught if they dumped the girl in Delhi. The girl told police that she was alone in the bus, which she had boarded at Noida Sector 63. She had come from Mainpuri.
Article Summary: A 16-year-old Class 11 student was allegedly gang-raped inside a sleeper bus. The incident occurred after the girl mistakenly got off at Pari Chowk amid heavy rain. Delhi Police arrested the bus driver and conductor from Uttar Pradesh.

Article Title: Sena UBT moves to disqualify 13 Dharashiv councillors, 4 panchayat samiti members
Article Text:
(FILE PHOTO) 10 Kalamb councillors, including 9 from Shiv Sena (UBT), join BJP; Kalamb municipal council left without opposition

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

: The Shiv Sena (UBT) has decided to initiate legal proceedings seeking the disqualification of 13 councillors and four panchayat samiti members in Dharashiv district who switched allegiance after being elected on the party’s mashaal (flaming torch) symbol.Dharashiv Sena (UBT) MLA Kailas Patil stated on Friday that the party would first approach the Dharashiv collector to seek the disqualification of these elected representatives. He added that if the collector fails to decide on the matter within the stipulated timeframe, the party will approach the Aurangabad bench of the Bombay High Court and, if necessary, the Supreme Court.The development is set to trigger unrest among the 13 councillors who crossed over—nine from Kalamb and four from Dharashiv. Following the defections, the party convened a meeting attended by Patil and party observers, where workers expressed strong resentment and resolved to pursue disqualification proceedings.Speaking to reporters in Dharashiv, Patil said the councillors and panchayat samiti members had secured their mandates on a Shiv Sena (UBT) ticket and the mashaal symbol. He noted that the party is currently consulting lawyers regarding the legal provisions applicable to these cases.“We are discussing the matter with legal experts and will initiate appropriate action at the earliest. We will initially approach the collector. If there is a delay in reaching a decision, we will move the high court to seek a time-bound ruling,” Patil said.He said the party would seek legal recourse against those who had betrayed the party, its workers, and ordinary voters by switching sides to the BJP after being elected on the Sena (UBT) symbol.The defections have intensified political tensions in Dharashiv, with the Thackeray faction alleging that representatives were lured into switching sides. Sena (UBT) co-contact chief Makarand Raje Nimbalkar alleged that bids ranging from Rs20 lakh to Rs1 crore were being offered to councillors.Nimbalkar claimed that MP Omraje Nimbalkar and BJP leader Rana Jagjitsinh Patil were behind the defections and accused them of creating a “market” for councillors. He argued that those elected on the mashaal symbol should resign before joining another party and seek a fresh mandate from the people.The Shiv Sena (UBT) has vowed not to tolerate these defections and intends to challenge the move through both legal and political channels.
Article Summary: The Shiv Sena (UBT) has decided to initiate legal proceedings seeking the disqualification of 13 councillors and four panchayat samiti members in Dharashiv district. The councillors switched allegiance after being elected on the party’s mashaal (flaming torch) symbol.

Article Title: FIR lodged after 3,400 SIR forms found in Navi Mumbai shop; 5 BLOs suspended
Article Text:
An FIR was registered against Suraj Patil for illegally possessing voter enumeration forms





NAVI MUMBAI: The police have registered an FIR against Suraj Patil, a nodal BJP youth wing committee member, for illegally possessing and converting special intensive revision (SIR) voter enumeration forms for “personal use” and for breaking the maintenance of secrecy of voting under Section 314 of the BNS and Section 128 of the Representation of People Act.Section 314 of the BNS deals with dishonestly converting a movable property for own use, for which the punishment is at least two years imprisonment.The matter came to light on Thursday, after an advocate working for the Shiv Sena (UBT) noticed hundreds of original SIR forms lying at a photocopier’s shop in Kharghar. He alerted the police.The accused (Patil) had decamped from the Kharghar police station, leading to high drama throughout the night.Authorities seized 3,404 SIR forms, including 11 blank ones, of 11 polling stations from the photocopier’s shop next to the Ramsheth Thakur Public School in Sector 19, Kharghar, by Shiv Sena (UBT) nodal chief Balesh Bhojane.Five booth-level officers (BLOs) served with show-cause notices were suspended by the Panvel City Municipal Corporation (PCMC) chief Mangesh Chitale.They include three data entry operators working as booth-level officers from a private company, Saunik Integrated & Security Pvt Ltd, Bhayandar, engaged by the PCMC.Their names are Sulochana Mane, Prashant Mhatre and Rahul Bhagat.The Shiv Sena (UBT) had earlier warned the Panvel sub-divisional officer through a letter about various lapses in the electoral process.A two-member inquiry committee comprising a Panvel deputy municipal commissioner, Nanasaheb Kamathe, and an assistant electoral registration officer, has been formed to conduct a comprehensive probe.Bhojane said, “MLAs Jitendra Awhad and Rohit Pawar have tweeted the video regarding the original SIR forms at the Kharghar shop. We demand action against the Panvel SDO as he did not take preventive measures despite our complaint about forms filed at the BJP offices. The FIR was filed only after more than hundreds of our workers assembled at the police station.”After learning about the incident, Raigad district communication head of Shiv Sena (UBT) Prasad Bhoir lodged a complaint with the electoral registration officer.“Yesterday evening, the election registration office (ERO) received information that a person is xeroxing enumeration forms at a Xerox centre at Kharghar sector 19. Immediately, the assistant election registration officer visited the site and found that one Suraj Patil was holding around 3,400 enumeration forms and xeroxing it illegally,” Raigad district collector Kishan Javale said.
Article Summary: Police have registered an FIR against Suraj Patil, a nodal BJP youth wing committee member, for illegally possessing and converting voter enumeration forms. The matter came to light on Thursday, after an advocate working for the Shiv Sena (UBT) noticed hundreds of original SIR forms lying at a photocopier’s shop in Kharghar.

Article Title: 3,400 SIR forms found at Navi Mumbai photocopy shop; 5 BLOs suspended as Sena (UBT)-BJP clash
Article Text:
Authorities seized numerous printed Special Intensive Revision forms from the premises

THANE/MUMBAI: Five Booth Level Officers (BLOs) were suspended after 3,400 enumeration forms related to the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of voter rolls were found at a private photocopy shop in Navi Mumbai’s Kharghar, triggering a political confrontation between Shiv Sena (UBT) and BJP workers and prompting an administrative inquiry, police and district officials said.The forms, which were filled by voters from the Panvel Assembly constituency, were found at a photocopy centre in Sector 19 following complaints that SIR applications were being photocopied there and that a person associated with the BJP youth wing was allegedly in unauthorised possession of them.Police rushed to the shop and took Suraj Patil, who was allegedly getting the forms photocopied, into custody.Authorities also seized thousands of printed SIR forms from the premises and shifted them to the police station, news agency PTI reported.he controversy came to light after a video related to the incident went viral on Thursday.The administration subsequently ordered an inquiry into how forms filled by voters reached a private photocopy centre.Following the complaint, the Electoral Registration Officer deputed Assistant Electoral Registration Officers to inspect the photocopy centre.During the inspection, officials found that Patil had brought 3,400 applications to the shop.Scrutiny showed that the forms belonged to 11 polling stations. A majority of the applications were from five polling stations, while single copies were found from six other polling stations.Shiv Sena (UBT) workers had confronted Patil at the shop, alleging that he was a BJP Youth Wing office-bearer. BJP workers, however, denied any connection with the matter.Sena (UBT) workers also alleged that Patil managed to flee the Kharghar police station shortly after being taken there for questioning.Raigad district collector Kishan Jawale on Friday said a case had been registered against Patil under the Representation of the People Act and the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.Jawale visited the office of Panvel Sub-Divisional Officer Pawan Chandak and said the five BLOs had been suspended pending disciplinary proceedings.Shiv Sena (UBT) office-bearer Balesh Bhojane questioned how SIR forms filled by ordinary voters could have reached private individuals and alleged that BJP youth wing functionaries were linked to the incident.Panvel Municipal Corporation mayor and BJP leader Nitin Patil, however, said party workers had no connection with the matter.Opposition NCP (SP) MLA Rohit Pawar said suspending the five BLOs was not enough and alleged that the incident exposed problems in the way the SIR process was being conducted."We have been saying that the BJP is using this process to ensure its poll victory and this incident proves us right," he said.Pawar said he had sought a response from the Election Commission over the incident, but the authorities had passed the responsibility to the Election Commission of India."Suspending only the BLOs is not enough. The authorities who instructed them should also be suspended, and action should be taken against the BJP workers involved," Pawar added.He also said there could be many similar incidents that had not been detected and sought a response from the Election Commission.(With agency inputs)
Article Summary: 5 Booth Level Officers (BLOs) suspended after 3,400 enumeration forms found at private photocopy shop in Navi Mumbai’s Kharghar. Police took Suraj Patil, who was allegedly getting the forms photocopied, into custody. Authorities also seized thousands of printed SIR forms from the premises.

Article Title: Draft electoral roll under SIR to be published on Aug 31, voters urged to check details: Pune district collector
Article Text:
District collector and district election officer Jitendra Dudi

Pune:





The draft electoral roll prepared under the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise will be published on Aug 31 this year, with district collector Jitendra Dudi, who is also the district election officer, urging voters to check the list and ensure that their names and details are reflected correctly.The draft roll will be available on the websites of the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) of Maharashtra and the Pune district collector and district election officer. Printed copies will also be made available at the offices of recognised political parties, tehsil offices and electoral registration offices.“Voters whose names are missing from the draft roll can apply for fresh registration by submitting Form 6. Those seeking to raise an objection regarding a name in the electoral roll can submit Form 7. Voters can use Form 8 to obtain an EPIC (elector photo identity card) and for making corrections in the electoral roll,” Dudi further said.The collector also said voters who are dissatisfied with any order passed by the Electoral Registration Officer (ERO) following a hearing related to the electoral roll can appeal against the decision before him, in his capacity as district election officer.An appeal against the decision of the district election officer can subsequently be filed before the Maharashtra CEO, Dudi said.
Article Summary: The draft electoral roll prepared under the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise will be published on Aug 31. The draft roll will be available on the websites of the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) of Maharashtra and the Pune district collector and district election officer.

Article Title: Torso in bag case: arrested couple brought to city
Article Text:
Busted

Chennai:





A couple arrested in Assam and Manipur in connection with the murder of a woman whose dismembered, headless body was found in a suitcase aboard the Tamil Nadu Express at Agra railway station were brought to Chennai under heavy police security.The accused, Manik Uddin Laskar and his wife Bhagabati Majhi, were brought from Guwahati to Chennai by an IndiGo passenger flight at around 9.30pm on Saturday after the Tambaram City Police obtained transit warrants from the respective courts where they were produced.The victim, Hayatun Nisha, 38, was staying with the suspects in Guduvanchery.The couple were taken from Chennai airport to the Tambaram City Police Commissionerate under tight security for further interrogation.The woman’s dismembered body parts, with the head missing, were found packed in a red suitcase in a rear coach of the Tamil Nadu Express at Agra railway station on August 5.
Article Summary: Manik Uddin Laskar and his wife Bhagabati Majhi were brought from Guwahati to Chennai by an IndiGo passenger flight at around 9.30pm on Saturday. The victim, Hayatun Nisha, 38, was staying with the suspects in Guduvanchery.

Article Title: Anbumani flays state govt for ‘not protecting’ Pallikaranai marsh
Article Text:
Environmental Issue

Chennai:





PMK president Anbumani Ramadoss flayed successive state govts for their alleged failure to protect Pallikaranai marsh and asked if the govts were `unfit’ to do conserve the marshland.Anbumani Ramadoss who led an awareness rally in Chennai demanding the notification of Pallikaranai marsh, questioned the reason for not `protecting’ the marsh. “Will you adopt the same approach if it was your own land?’’ he asked the state govt. Pasumai Thayagam president Sowmiya Anbumani also participated in the rally.Anbumani then questioned the silence of chief minister C Joseph Vijay on Cauvery issue . “Why is he not convening the all party meeting?’’ he asked. Anbumani said Vijay should not remain silent just because the state govt has approached the Supreme Court against Mekedatu dam. “We should exert political pressure too,’’ he said. He said that Vijay should take his ministers to New Delhi and meet Prime minister Narendra Modi to prevent Mekedatu dam.On the shelved Parandur airport plan, Anbumani said a water body spread across 5000 acres should be created in the place where the govt had acquired land for the airport. “We disagree with govt’s plan to set up industries in the land acquired for airport. Instead the water bodies located in the land should be connected and a huge lake should be created. This will address water requirements for Chennai,’’ he said.
Article Summary: PMK president Anbumani Ramadoss flayed successive state govts for their alleged failure to protect Pallikaranai marsh. He asked the state govt. if they were 'unfit' to do conserve the marshland. He also questioned the silence of chief minister C Joseph Vijay on Cauvery issue.

Article Title: Three ambulance drivers arrested for cutting birthday cakes with machete near Pollachi
Article Text:
Suresh celebrated his birthday on Thursday night with his friends near the CTC Medu new bus stand. They placed two cakes on a stretcher used for transporting patients and cut them with a machete.





COIMBATORE: The Mahalingapuram police in Coimbatore district have arrested three ambulance drivers for celebrating the birthday of one of them by cutting two cakes with a machete near the CTC Medu bus stand on the Pollachi–Coimbatore Road.The arrested have been identified as Suresh, 35, Vanjinathan, 32 and Vengadesan, 30, of Pollachi.Suresh celebrated his birthday on Thursday night with his friends near the CTC Medu new bus stand. They placed two cakes on a stretcher used for transporting patients and cut them with a machete.The video of the incident surfaced online, triggering widespread outrage and concern. Following this, the Mahalingapuram police registered a case and arrested the three men who were in the video.Police seized the machete used for cutting the cakes. The arrested men were remanded in judicial custody.
Article Summary: Suresh celebrated his birthday on Thursday night with his friends near the CTC Medu new bus stand. They placed two cakes on a stretcher used for transporting patients and cut them with a machete. The video of the incident surfaced online, triggering widespread outrage and concern.

Article Title: Farmer abducted from Hosur
Article Text: KRISHNAGIRI: A farmer was abducted by two men who arrived in a car near his house at Kelamangalam in Hosur on Friday night. Police have registered a case and launched an intensive hunt.The abducted farmer has been identified as Gopal,58, of Anusoni village near Kelamangalam.According to sources, two unidentified men arrived near Gopal’s house in a car bearing a Kerala registration number around 7 pm on Friday. They called him out of his residence under the pretext of striking up a conversation. Moments later, the duo forcibly pushed Gopal into the vehicle and sped away.The incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera. Gopal’s wife retrieved the footage and lodged a formal complaint at the Kelamangalam police station.Based on her complaint, police opened an investigation to determine the motive behind the abduction. A special police team has been formed to rescue Gopal and apprehend the culprits.
Article Summary: The abducted farmer has been identified as Gopal,58, of Anusoni village near Kelamangalam. Two unidentified men arrived near Gopal’s house in a car bearing a Kerala registration number. They called him out of his residence under the pretext of striking up a conversation. Moments later, they forcibly pushed Gopal into the vehicle and sped away.

Article Title: Two dead as school bus collides head-on with bike in Krishnagiri
Article Text:
Krishnagiri:

Two men died on the spot after a private school bus collided head-on with their two-wheeler near Hosur in Krishnagiri district on Friday morning.The deceased have been identified as Anbarasan, 50, and Sampath Kumar, 52, residents of Mookandapalli near Hosur in Krishnagiri. Both were involved in real estate business.Police said the accident took place when a private school bus was heading towards Hosur after picking up students from surrounding villages along the Hosur Kakkanur route. “When the bus reached Nallur, it collided head-on with an oncoming two-wheeler at high speed. On impact, both occupants of the two-wheeler were thrown off the vehicle and died on the spot,” said an officer. All school children travelling on the bus escaped unhurt.Nallur police who were alerted, recovered the bodies, and sent them to the Hosur govt headquarters hospital for postmortem.A case has been registered, and the school bus driver is being interrogated.
Article Summary: The deceased have been identified as Anbarasan, 50, and Sampath Kumar, 52, residents of Mookandapalli near Hosur in Krishnagiri. Both were involved in real estate business. Police said the accident took place when a private school bus was heading towards Hosur after picking up students.

Article Title: Congress minister threatens to quit TVK cabinet if Rahul not accepted as PM candidate in 2029
Article Text: MADURAI: Signalling a fresh strain in the ruling coalition, Congress leader and Tamil Nadu tourism minister S Rajesh Kumar threatened to quit the state cabinet if TVK refuses to accept Rahul Gandhi as the prime ministerial candidate in 2029 Lok Sabha elections.“Rahul Gandhi will be the prime ministerial candidate for the 2029 parliamentary election. He will become the next PM. If at all TVK refuses the accept this, the two Congress ministers will walk out of the cabinet,” Rajesh Kumar said on Sunday at the swearing in ceremony of George Robinson as Congress party’s Kanyakumari West district unit. "For us, party is above all other considerations. Our cadres want to see Rahul Gandhi as PM. Our goal is to achieve that,’’ he said.The remark comes against the backdrop of repeated attempts by TVK leaders to project chief minister C Joseph Vijay as a potential prime ministerial face from Tamil Nadu in 2029.The issue was first raised by PWD minister Aadhav Arjuna during a debate on delimitation exercise when he said a Prime Minister should emerge from Tamil Nadu. His remarks were followed by other TVK ministers, including D Sarathkumar, A Srinath and K Jagadeeswari, projecting Vijay as a possible prime ministerial candidate.The debate gained traction nationally after a private media house said their survey has found Vijay was the third most preferred prime ministerial choice in the country, following Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi.The statements by TVK leaders sparked unease among the Congress rank and file. When asked about the issue, Tamil Nadu Congress Committee president Manickam Tagore took a swipe at TVK ministers, saying they were still functioning with a “fan club mindset.”Rajesh Kumar’s warning, however, marks an escalation of the disagreement. The support of five MLAs of Congress remains crucial for TVK to enjoy the majority mark in the state assembly. In return, TVK has given two ministerial berths to Congress leaders Rajesh Kumar and Viswanathan. Earlier in the day, Viswanathan too said Rahul Gandhi was their PM candidate and there would be no change in the stand.
Article Summary: Tamil Nadu tourism minister S Rajesh Kumar threatened to quit the state cabinet if TVK refuses to accept Rahul Gandhi as the prime ministerial candidate in 2029 Lok Sabha elections. The remark comes against the backdrop of repeated attempts by TVK leaders to project chief minister C Joseph Vijay as a potential prime ministerial face from Tamil Nadu. The support of five MLAs of Congress remains crucial for TVK to enjoy the majority mark.

Article Title: HC directs state to issue GO for release of water from Amaravathi dam in Karur
Article Text: Madras high court on Friday directed state govt to issue a GO to release water from Amaravathi dam for drinking water for Karur district and irrigation purposes in the old Amaravathi ayacut starting from August 30.
Article Summary: Madras high court on Friday directed state govt to issue a GO to release water from Amaravathi dam. Water will be released for drinking water for Karur district and irrigation purposes in the old Amaravathy ayacut starting from August 30.

Article Title: Salem corporation council meeting disrupted over mayor’s demand for removal of deputy mayor chair from dais
Article Text: COIMBATORE: Tension flared at the Salem corporation council meeting on Friday when mayor A Ramachandran, who belongs to DMK, refused to conduct the proceedings, insisting that the chair of deputy mayor Saradha Devi, who belongs to Congress, be moved from the dais.The council meeting of Salem corporation, scheduled to begin at 11am, started 20 minutes late after the mayor entered the hall. Instead of taking his designated seat, the mayor sat among the councillors and declared that he would not preside over the session. He stated that during the previous council meeting, he had ordered to remove the deputy mayor’s seat from near the mayor’s chair. However, he alleged that the Salem corporation commissioner overruled his directive and insisted on retaining deputy mayor’s chair next to that of the mayor. “I will not conduct this meeting where I am not given the authority,” Ramachandran said.DMK councillors protested demanding the removal of the deputy mayor’s chair from the dais. When corporation staffers attempted to remove the chair, Saradha Devi launched a sit-in protest in the council hall. She accused the mayor of showing gender bias and disrespect.She said, “The mayor does not give me the respect I deserve because I am a woman.My chair has been right next to the mayor’s for the last four years; why should it be removed now? I respect this council, and I will not allow my seat to be moved.”Following the uproar, a closed-door reconciliation meeting was convened between the corporation commissioner, mayor, deputy mayor, and DMK councillors. Emerging from the discussions, Saradha Devi alleged, “They spoke about shifting my seat from the dais and asked whether I wanted the ‘chair’ or a ‘share.’ I made it clear that I only want my chair.”The deadlock remained unresolved. Upon returning to the council hall, mayor Ramachandran announced that all resolutions were postponed due to the disruption. He left the hall after that. However, Saradha Devi continued her protest.Tension between Congress and DMK councillors started after the national party left the DMK alliance to join the TVK govt in the state in May.
Article Summary: DMK councillors protested demanding the removal of the deputy mayor’s chair from the dais. When corporation staffers attempted to remove the chair, Saradha Devi launched a sit-in protest in the council hall. She accused the mayor of showing gender bias and disrespect.

Article Title: Lady doctor arrested near Salem for illegal fetal gender determination
Article Text: SALEM: Police on Wednesday arrested a lady doctor in Vazhapadi in Salem district on charges of illegally determining and disclosing the gender of fetuses to pregnant women. Health department officials seized scan equipment, abortion pills and cash from a clinic the doctor, Selvamba Rajkumar, was running in the area. They sealed the clinic.Authorities said the clinic on the Cuddalore Road charged pregnant women additional fees to reveal the gender of the unborn child.Acting on a complaint, a team led by joint director Dr S P Nandhini, Attur district health officer Dr N Yoganand and Vazhapadi Government Hospital chief medical officer Dr Ramesh Kumar raided the facility.They found that Dr Selvamba Rajkumar had received Rs 30,000 from a pregnant woman to determine the gender of her fetus. Dr Nandini said the doctor had been handed over to police for legal proceedings.Health department officials said this was not the first violation by the clinic. It had been raided twice earlier, and Dr Selvamba Rajkumar had faced restrictions on conducting scans and treatments, they said. Cases were registered against her then too.
Article Summary: Health department officials seized scan equipment, abortion pills and cash from a clinic the doctor, Selvamba Rajkumar, was running. Authorities said the clinic on the Cuddalore Road charged pregnant women additional fees to reveal the gender of the unborn child. Dr Nandini said the doctor had been handed over to police for legal proceedings.

Article Title: Vadakkenchery Police register case against ex-DYFI activist for fake degree
Article Text:
Police have intensified the search to trace the accused, K V Ganapathy from Kizhakkegramam, after he allegedly went into hiding

Palakkad

:





Vadakkenchery Police have registered a case against a former local DYFI activist for allegedly attempting to secure a temporary job at a panchayat using a fake degree certificate purportedly issued by the Calicut university. Police have intensified the search to trace the accused, K V Ganapathy from Kizhakkegramam, after he allegedly went into hiding.Police said Ganapathy had submitted a certificate while applying for the post of accountant-cum-IT assistant under Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS) at Pudukkode panchayat. The certificate was found to be fake during verification by the panchayat secretary.The panchayat subsequently informed the police, who registered a case against Ganapathy on Aug 24. The FIR states that he allegedly attempted to deceive the state govt and the panchayat by submitting a fake consolidated grade card in the name of the University of Calicut.The police have invoked provisions under BNS relating to breach of trust, cheating and forgery.Police verification also revealed that Ganapathy had worked under the MGNREGS in Pudukkode panchayat for five years until last month, allegedly using the same documents.The panchayat committee had earlier decided not to extend his employment contract after the tenure of temporary employees ended. Ganapathy challenged the decision in the Kerala high court, which stayed it.Following that, the panchayat verified his certificates and sent them to the Calicut university. The university reportedly informed the panchayat that although Ganapathy had registered as a degree student, he had not completed the course.Following the university’s response, the panchayat secretary lodged a complaint with the police. Ganapathy reportedly went into hiding after the alleged forgery came to light.
Article Summary: Police have intensified the search to trace the accused, K V Ganapathy from Kizhakkegramam. He allegedly submitted a certificate while applying for the post of accountant-cum-IT assistant under Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme. The certificate was found to be fake during verification by the panchayat secretary.

Article Title: KMRL MD Loknath Behera’s tenure not extended
Article Text:
Kochi:





The state govt has not extended the tenure of current Kochi Metro Rail Ltd (KMRL) MD Loknath Behera, former DGP of Kerala. His tenure will expire on Aug 30.The transport department secretary issued an order on Saturday announcing that Ernakulam collector G Priyanka will temporarily hold the charge of KMRL MD until further orders, in addition to her existing duties. She will be in charge of the post from Monday.Behera was appointed as MD of KMRL in 2021 on a re-employment basis and his tenure was extended two times, in 2024 and 2025 by then LDF govt.Alkesh Kumar Sharma was the MD before Behera assumed office. Behera had recently courted controversy over the proposed renaming of KMRL as Keralam Metro Rail. It invited criticism from chief minister V D Satheesan questioning the authority of KMRL to propose renaming without consulting with the state govt.
Article Summary: Loknath Behera was appointed as MD of Kochi Metro Rail Ltd in 2021. His tenure was extended two times, in 2024 and 2025 by then LDF govt. Ernakulam collector G Priyanka will temporarily hold the charge of KMRL MD.
